notes.title: batch is ready to take off!
notes.content:
It was a long way, but we finally did it! batch (the former YouTube Center) is ready to be the most powerful YouTube uploading software on planet. Maybe of the whole galaxy!

We made tons of corrections and created new stuff for you in the last two months. So here we go!

[h1]Whats new?[/h1]

[b]The new UI[/b]

We created a complete new interface which helps you doing things much faster than ever.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34279175/45d524a2c5b336ee69dce54b7c5b20f551692c05.png[/img]

We reworked the whole design to make it more beautiful and handy.
We brought the queue to the right side, so you can access it from every part of the software. You can show or hide the queue, as you like. This will help you to get a fast overview of your current uploads.

We brought in new modal windows, which keeps the UI more clean and focused.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34279175/55a4c36013341750465fee6d3d6e97d333e9de0d.png[/img]

We changed to concept of using the software to a more channel-driven way. Your channel rules everything so you can focus yourself more on what you want to do. For switching fast between your channels, we build a handy channel-switcher.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34279175/0b84b5f8969e4111adaddc587a13b669fdfde6f0.png[/img] 

[b]New functions[/b]

If you are new to batch, you might have some questions, so we created a new help center, in which hopefully all your questions will be answered.

We reworked the logic of the queue completely, so entries will be better sorted and uploaded in the right order. But if you start an upload manually it gets a higher priority and will be uploaded first. 
We brought in a feature which blocks the power saving mode while batch is uploading.

If you work with more than one channel you are now able to share uploads between your channels. There is also a new share button in the queue entries. This will copy the sharelink of your uploading video to the clipboard.

We reworked the search logic on YouTube. This will bring much better search results.

We changed the way of how you can reply to your comments. It is much simplier and more intuitiv than before.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34279175/04d0d2c3db42af0df1fd8ee02f1da3d0262c6ac4.png[/img]

[h1]What we fixed[/h1]

There are tons of corrections, we've made. Here a small uncomplete list of fixes and corrections.
[list]
[*] We added missing translations
[*] We fixed an authentification bug
[*] There was a bug which let batch upload videos twice
[*] The length of the tags was calculated wrong
[*] The executing of tasks was broken
[*] The upload speed reset after every new start of the software
[*] We increased the maximum upload speed to 1000 MBit/s
[*] In some cases the templates weren't saved proper
[*] In some cases when your PC lost connection, the upload was aborted. Now batch just waits for a reconnection
[*] Many, many more...
[/list]

We hope you have fun with our new batch.

Best regards
Benjamin

If you are someone who loves to use shortcuts: This is an update for you! We added shortcuts to the templates. They are explained closer in the Help Center.

If you are working with more than one channel, you will find a new button in the templates and you can upload a template to another channel than the related one. After a click on the new button you only have to select the channel you want to upload to and the playlist.

In the queue you find a Share button for every entry. By a click on this button the link to your video copied to the clipboard. This link is also displayed and by a click batch opens your browser and directing you to YouTube.

We've also updated the Help Center for you.

[h1]Bug Fix[/h1]

There was a problem in the queue. If a package wasn't uploaded successfully an error occurred and the entry stopped uploading after a while. This is fixed now. Thanks for reporting the bug!

notes.title: Say hello to batch!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34279175/06f17dabefa347b5c391c2745ae7f62cdfceef1b.png[/img]

I am very proud to announce, that with the next major version the 'YouTube Center' will be called 'batch'. 
The new name is closer to our vision for this software in the future. In the last couple of months we worked very hard on the new upcoming version of batch and created a complete new interface to give you the ability doing things faster and more simple than today.

[h1]What’s new?[/h1]
We came up with the idea, that it would be very handy, if you have access to the queue from every part of the software. So, we done it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34279175/45d524a2c5b336ee69dce54b7c5b20f551692c05.png[/img]

The queue is placed on the right side. You can minimize or maximize it, as you like. Also you can see, that we updated the dark mode. All elements are compatible now and have a nice dark look. In the top of the page, you see another new element: The account selector.

If you work with more than one account, it gives you a simpler way to switch between your channels.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34279175/0b84b5f8969e4111adaddc587a13b669fdfde6f0.png[/img]

You also don’t need to select a ‘type’ in your templates anymore. batch is more channel-driven than today. 

Another new element are the modal dialogs. They will bring a better overview and keep the UI more clean.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34279175/ec2318db4b532735176d499d6fa9575518bc46a4.png[/img]

We reduced the white space and tried to create a consistent UI for you and hope you will have fun with it.

[h1]When you will get it?[/h1]
We are very far in progress and started a testing period. Now, we have to wait for the feedback of our beta testers. There are small changes to do, too. Your current version will get further updates if needed, like in the last couple of weeks. But our main focus is on the new version.

Hope you liked, what you saw!

Have a nice day
Benjamin

notes.title: Welcome to version 1.1.0!
notes.content:
I'm very proud to present you a new version filled with new features! Take a minute to explore the new stuff.

[h1]The queue and uploads[/h1]

I've rewritten all the code for the queue and uploads from scratch and added some exciting and useful features.
Uploads and the queue now update every second. This has many advantages for you. The upload speed and progress are calculated much more accurately. In the previous version unlikely speeds could be displayed again and again. This is a thing of the past.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34279175/893a66952ad62bd14f6aed7e0f28934de415ab2a.png[/img]

Also the total progress is now calculated continuously and a probable remaining time is displayed. Another new feature is that the power management of the computer is now taken into account. Before the PC goes into sleep mode, the entire queue is paused and automatically restarted as soon as the PC wakes up. In the settings, you can also specify whether the YouTube Center should prevent the sleep mode during the upload. Once all uploads have been completed, the program will return you to sleep mode.

From this version on you will find this new button in the queue:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34279175/4d68a1461f4476a4db10b84541212eadc659adb8.png[/img] 
With a click on this button you activate the queue monitoring and following button appears:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34279175/b598893a9a9f09d2f0ae5595a290449b96615535.png[/img]

The queue monitor keeps the queue permanently in upload mode. As soon as a new upload is added, it is started. This mode is off by default every time the YouTube Center starts.

I have reduced the number of requests sent to YouTube to one tenth. This significantly increases the overall speed.

[h1]Tasks[/h1]

In the templates you will find a new tab. Here you can define what should happen with the original files after the successful upload.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34279175/be220e01db5b0578c7abd242b04b8e6332e4efd3.png[/img]

Possible tasks are:
[list]
[*] Rename video file
[*] Copy video file
[*] Delete video file
[*] Move video file
[*] Rename thumbnail file
[*] Copy thumbnail file
[*] Delete thumbnail file
[*] Move thumbnail file
[/list]

You also have the possibility to combine different tasks with each other. For example: Copy and rename a video file. Only when all tasks have been completed will the program allow the PC to enter sleep mode if it is activated. I'm looking forward to your feedback on this new feature. Are you still missing tasks? Please let me know.

[h1]Further new features[/h1]

I have added two new languages: Russian and Italian. Please give me feedback on the translations.
I've adjusted the notifications. If several notifications follow one another, they are now displayed one below the other instead of one above the other. They can also be closed individually.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34279175/f2f477b2375e7f1b334edd3283a573f5609d1529.png[/img]

I have also rearranged the settings for the new features and hope that the individual entries are more logical. I made some small changes in the interface. Modal windows have a higher contrast than the rest and are therefore more visible. I rounded the corners a bit and made the appearance a bit softer. I also corrected some mistakes in the English language.


I hope you have fun with the new features!

notes.title: Something big is coming
notes.content:
Normally there was an update every week. The last one was two weeks ago. There's a reason for that: At the moment I'm working on a big update! There will be some great new features that I'd like to talk about briefly:

[h1]Uploads[/h1]
I completely redesigned and rewrote the entire uploader and queue. This brings great new features and possibilities. The new uploader updates itself every second. The progress and speed of an upload is recalculated every second. This makes the process smoother. Internally, the uploads have been completely restructured, which also shortens the overall upload time.

There is a new feature called "Tasks". In the templates you can define what should happen to a file that has been uploaded. It can be moved, renamed, deleted or copied. This applies to the video and the thumbnail file. Only when all tasks have been completed will the PC shut down if this is set.

I've integrated a Power Managemanet. If the computer goes into sleep mode during the upload, all current entries are paused. If the PC wakes up, the queue continues. However, it is possible to prevent this sleep mode while the upload is still running. 

The new queue will be activated automatically. If there are any problems you can return to the old version via the settings.

[h1]Translations[/h1]
There will be two new languages:
Italian and Russian. I would be very grateful for feedback. I will have the translations checked by native speakers in the near future.

[h1]New notifications[/h1]
I've revised the notifications. These are now much more functional and above all more beautiful. Notifications that are displayed shortly after each other are now displayed below each other and can be closed individually. Previously they were displayed on top of each other. Not very nice.

[h1]GUI[/h1]
I've made some minor changes to the GUI to add a little more contrast to the interface. This is especially true for modal windows. More shadows are used here to emphasize these windows. I also rounded the buttons a bit to make the surface look less hard. I hope you like the changes.

The new version will be released in the next days, but probably tomorrow. I'm looking forward to your feedback.

Best regards
Benjamin

There is a new feature called "Tasks".
I've integrated a Power Managemanet.
There will be two new languages: Italian and Russian.
I've revised the notifications. These are now much more functional and above all more beautiful.

notes.title: A big Update with cool new features is here for you!
notes.content:
Welcome to a new version of the YouTube Center. I have cool new things for you!

[h1]Templates[/h1]
You find new options for editing and creating you templates. I changed the icon for creating the title. Now you can add the title to your description and we added the text blocks to the tags, so you can save tags you often use.

[h1]The video player[/h1]
I updated the video player. There where some functions missing. Now you find the information about the duration of a video and the time the video is already played. Also you can smoothly seeking through the video, now.

[h1]Search results[/h1]
I've done some work on the searching results, so they will be more relevant for you. I added also a rating button to the videos and the playlist items, so you can rate videos you like or even dislike.

[h1]Stabilty[/h1]
I've done a lot of work to make the YouTube Center more stable. Also I added a new logging system to the renderer process.

[h1]The complete list[/h1]
[list]
[*] You get the ability to rate videos and playlist items
[*] New time controls in the video Player
[*] Smootly seeking the video in the Player
[*] Like or dislike videos.
[*] From now on I inform you about new features with this window.
[*] The search function on YouTube brings better search results for you.
[*] Now you can add the title of your video to the description, like you know it from editing the video title. For a better usability I changed the icon for this feature.
[*] The text blocks feature comes to the tags. You can save standard tags for reusing.
[*] The video player has a better playlist integration.
[*] I added a live preview while editing text blocks
[*] Modal windows have a better contrast now. I hope you like the new style.
[*] By deleting a text block, all templates will be updated.
[*] The whitespace between tags will be removed automaticly.
[*] By updating the video file in your templates the recording date of the video will be set to the creation date of the video file.
[/list]

[h1]The list of fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Better stability and resource management
[*] The video is centered to screen in fullscreen mode
[*] Better error logging in the renderer process
[*] We try to prevent bugs like the grey screen bug. If the renderer process crashes it will restart automaticly. Please stay in touch and report bugs like this.
[*] Open a window for adding a new account took a very long time. Now it's fixed.
[/list]
